scope: Independent scientific branch and gate implementation review; exact future release requires a separate hash-bound review.
authorship_disclosure: Reviewer authored endpoints.py and its tests; runner.py and decisions.py were independently authored and independently reviewed here.
checks: All six unseeded source dyads remain in the 480-cell assignment; first-wave assignment explicitly selects reference1 only and does not depend on recovery outcomes.
Each endpoint/role/phase uses the same four fixtures and order across all five arms; each set contains two correct and two faulty cases.

Original system messages match fresh_history exactly. Retained branches deep-copy only the selected actor's exact endpoint history; reset branches contain only the identical system before intervention.
Neutral/correction messages are lower-priority user messages. Correction/reset occur once per sequential branch; independent probes restart from their assigned endpoint.
Full and constrained packet construction differ only in exact evidence chunks; evaluator oracle fields are not included in model requests.
Precomputed request_body equals execute_decision's actual request construction, including forced submit_verdict.

Source-order provider output items are preserved exactly for sequential replay, including IDs/phases/opaque state. Only the actual verdict's original syntactic acknowledgment is appended; no truth/reward feedback.
Wrong valid verdicts continue sequentially; malformed/refused responses receive no invented acknowledgment, terminate only their branch, and leave the unattempted tail unknown.
All six fresh capability responses must be valid and correct before any research branch. Wrong or invalid capability produces zero research calls.
Analysis receives a copied 480-cell schedule with frozen completion availability. Unavailable/unattempted/invalid outcomes remain unknown; first wave is not full-study completion.

Pre-dispatch recomputation rejects drift from frozen initial request digests; post-response provenance also matches the frozen body. The repair-started marker requires a persisted HTTP response/body or HTTP status artifact, not a reservation alone.

tests.gate_simulation: Three fully mocked run() branches with all 56 initial request bindings populated and actual request digests checked. All provider/accounting/credential/artifact functions replaced locally. No HTTP/provider invocation or induction mutation.

findings_resolved.issue: Source availability omitted from reporting schedule, leaving availability cohort empty.
findings_resolved.resolution: runner now passes an annotated copy containing source_available and separately reports completed_source_endpoints and wave_sources.

limitations: One source dyad gives exploratory within-source contrasts, not population repair efficacy or validated collusion recovery.
Fixtures are fixed experimenter-generated code-review traces, not fresh adaptive peer behavior.
Sequential diagnostic carryover is not autonomous dyadic relapse or long-run persistence.
This review excludes admin handoff/accounting/security clearance, handled by separate reviewers.
Source hashes must still match this report when the final release is frozen; this implementation report is not authorization to bypass the exact-release audit.
